_readme: This file is the Reels page. Paste a reel URL in, rebuild, done — no
code change to add a reel.
Each entry in `reels`:
url       required. The full reel URL, straight from the address bar.
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/reel/SHORTCODE/
TikTok:    https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/1234567890
Short links (vm.tiktok.com) don't work — open one in a
browser first and paste the URL it lands on.
platform  required. "instagram" or "tiktok". If it disagrees with
the URL, the URL wins and the build says so.
caption   optional. Your line under the clip. The player itself is
the platform's; this caption is the site's voice.
added     optional. A date, for your own bookkeeping. Not displayed.
Entries that can't be embedded are skipped with a build warning, never
shipped broken. A reel deleted upstream after shipping degrades on the
page itself: the caption stays, the player becomes a marked
'no longer available' state.
Nothing is downloaded or rehosted — clips play through Instagram and
TikTok's own embeds and belong to their creators. The three entries
below are working samples; delete them when you have your own.

reels.caption: José Andrés, on what would have been Bourdain's birthday.
Jonathan Kite doing Bourdain at a Costco. The voice is unnervingly close.
On why he was a bridge, not just a chef.
